name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
label: Quest
description: Epic Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of great power?

I must warn you; purchases made at honored reputation with the Dawn come with an extremely hefty surcharge. I would advise that you gain a better reputation with the Dawn before moving forward with your plans.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good day, friend. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
